paite: Mi akinak ua, vaihawmna mun a ahoh uleh, vaihawmte'n ana gensak ding ua, midiktat siam atangsak ding ua, migilou moh atangsak ding uhi.
heading: Migilou Gawtna Dan

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, migilou zep tuak mah ahihleh, vaihawmmi in alumsak dia, ama ah azep ding ahi. Agitlouh dungzui a zep ding zah bikhiah ding ahi.
Sawmli vei tan zep theih ahi dia, huai val zaw hilou in. Hiai sang a val azepleh na unaupa uh na zahlaksak lo kha ding uh.
Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk na gak ding uh ahi kei.

Unaute tengkhawm uhenla, tapa nei lou in alak ua khat si taleh, asipa zi in polam a midang akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apasal unaupa in aluah dia, zi in anei dia, apasal unau mohpuakna tung ah ahih ding ahi.
heading: Unaupa Sih Tung A Mohpuakna

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atachil suansak in Israel lak a, amin amanlouhna ding in a-unau sipa min apu ding ahi.

Ama'n a-unaupa zi kitenpih a-ut keileh, kulh kongpi a upate kiang ah a-unaupa zi ahohtou dia, "Ka pasal unaupa'n Israel lak a a-unaupa min omsak zel a-ut kei a, ka pasal unaupa hih ding ka tung ah ahih nuam kei," ava chi ding hi.
Huchi in akho upate un amah asam ding ua, ahoupih ding ua ama'n, "Ka kitenpih nuam kei," chi a apanleh;

a-unaupa zi akiang ah upate ma ah ahong dia, upate ma ava naihtou dia, akhedap asuahsak dia, amai ah achil ase ding hi. "A-unaupa inkuan khotuah nuamloupa tung ah hichibang a hih hi ngeingei hen," achi ding hi.
Huchi in inkuan khedap suahsakpa, chi in Israelte lak ah amin putsak ahi ding hi.
Mikilai uhenla, akhat penpa zi in akilaihpihpa a pan apasal honkhe ding in azahmoh kaihsak taleh;
heading: Dan Dangte

paite: akhut na tansak ding uh ahi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei.
Na ip sung uah bukna suang chi tuamtuam, agik leh azang na nei ding uh ahi kei.
Na inn uah tehna chi tuamtuam, alian leh aneu na kem ding uh ahi kei,
Bukna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Tehna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon gam piak ah na damsawt ding uhi.
Huchibang hihmi, diktat loutak a hih tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un akih hi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi ua Amalekte'n hon na bawldan uh:
heading: Amalekte That Dia Thupiak

paite: Pathian leng lau lou a, na bah lai uh leh na nguai lai ua lampi a hon kituahpih a, na lak ua ananungpente, na nunglam ua hatloute, na bah lai leh na gim lai ua hon na sualdante uh theigige un.

Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia gam ahon piak chiang in, na kim ua na melma tengteng ua pan TOUPA na Pathian un galmuanna ahon piak chiang in van nuai a Amalekte theihgigena na hihmang sipsip ding uhi. Na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei.
